#: canopy-sandbox's template for worker_cmd, private_worker_cmd, and split_cmd (HOST_ISOLATION §4.2, §4.3). Copy
it to ~/.config/canopy/sandbox/worker.json, then fill in your hosts and trim the toolchains to yours. Keys
starting with # are comments; @NAME@ strings are the paths canopy-sandbox fills in for each run.
Everything not listed is refused. Add your model provider's API host, your tracker's MCP endpoint, every
internal MCP service your agents use, and the package registries your builds and tests fetch from. Git pushes
go over HTTPS: a sandbox cannot reach the SSH agent's socket.
Reads under HOME are denied, then re-allowed where the run needs them; allowRead outranks denyRead. Writes
are denied everywhere except allowWrite; denyWrite outranks allowWrite. If your workspace is outside HOME,
add it to denyRead, so its .canopy/ stays hidden. To push, add what your git credential helper reads to
allowRead: ~/.config/gh for gh, ~/.git-credentials for the store helper.
